fomod.Name: OStim Together
fomod.Author: OStim Together project
fomod.Description: Synchronizes OStim Standalone scenes through Skyrim Together Reborn. v0.37.0 preserves the mirror-only OCum model: OStim Together never changes what OCum Ascended renders on the real local player. CumOverlay snapshots now also carry the owner's actual live visible/hidden state. Hidden overlays therefore remain hidden on the remote proxy, while owner-visible Body overlays are relinked to the proxy's current body geometry and given the same visibility. PPA synchronization, scene anchors and alignment are unchanged.
